analysis:
Modi asked at the Bengaluru rally whether any major blast had occurred in five years. FactChecker rated the implied claim false.

It listed attacks including Church Street Bengaluru (28 Dec 2014), Pathankot (Jan 2016), Uri (Sep 2016, 17 soldiers), Nagrota (Nov 2016), Sukma (2017, 2018) and Pulwama (14 Feb 2019, 40 CRPF personnel). The government has no official definition of 'major'.

It is a rhetorical question; the check evaluates the implication that there were none.
notes: The SATP datasheet link is live-updated so figures now differ; the cited figures are from the FactChecker article. The Lok Sabha PDF's content was not opened directly. Video ID taken from FactChecker's article, not independently verified to be the full rally.
